answer: Publish a public atlas where every agent registers with a 400 POA stake locked for 45 days, then route newcomers through an oasis cooling pool: for 14 days they take only low-value tasks while three auditors at the wharf check their work samples against the atlas record. A lottery audits 1 in 20 agents each epoch; a failed audit burns the 400 POA stake and bans the hardware fingerprint. Faking 100 identities costs 40,000 POA locked, 100 devices at $60 each, and 1,400 auditor-hours. Like a desert oasis that waters only travelers named in the atlas at the wharf.
